instruction: On my farm, how can I be reasonably sure it is fall armyworm before deciding on any action?
response: Combine several signs: whorl-concentrated ragged feeding with moist frass, the pale inverted-Y on the dark head, and four dark dorsal spots forming a square near the rear. Any single sign alone is weaker. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: On my farm, how should I manage fall armyworm at the seedling stage of maize?
response: At the seedling stage plants are vulnerable, so scout frequently and destroy egg masses and young larvae by hand where practical. Base any further action on scouting, not a calendar. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, my maize is at the whorl stage. What is the priority for fall armyworm now?
response: The whorl stage is when FAW feeding is usually most intense, so focus scouting inside the whorls for fresh damage and moist frass and act according to your local threshold. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, the maize is tasselling and forming cobs. How does fall armyworm management change?
response: At tasselling and cob formation, check tassels, silks and ears as well as whorls, since larvae move to reproductive parts. Weigh any spraying against the pre-harvest interval on the product label. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, what is push-pull and can it help against fall armyworm?
response: Push-pull is a habitat-management method that intercrops a repellent plant with maize and borders the field with an attractant grass to reduce pest pressure. Treat it as a preventive, location-specific option and set it up with local extension guidance. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, can trap crops or intercropping reduce fall armyworm damage?
response: Crop diversification and border or trap plantings can lower FAW pressure in some systems as part of an integrated approach, but effects vary by location, so treat them as prevention rather than a guaranteed fix. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, does ploughing or tillage help control fall armyworm?
response: Tillage can expose FAW pupae in the soil to predators and drying, contributing to control as one part of integrated management rather than a standalone solution. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, the agro-dealer is out of the insecticide I usually use for fall armyworm. What can I do?
response: Ask for another product registered for FAW on maize in your area, or lean on non-chemical measures like hand-destroying egg masses and young larvae. Follow the label of whatever product you actually use, not the one you couldn't get. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, can you explain the fall armyworm life cycle simply?
response: FAW passes through egg, larva (the caterpillar that damages maize), pupa in the soil, and adult moth. The moths fly long distances to lay new eggs, and how fast a generation completes depends on temperature. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: On my farm, why does fall armyworm keep coming back to my field?
response: Adult moths migrate and lay new egg masses, so fresh infestations can arrive even after you clear larvae. This is why ongoing scouting and prevention matter more than a single treatment. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: On my farm, it rained heavily soon after I sprayed for fall armyworm. What should I do?
response: Heavy rain shortly after application can wash off product and reduce control. Check the label for its rainfast period and re-application guidance before deciding to spray again, rather than assuming it worked or reapplying blindly. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

response: Mi ò lè dájú pátápátá láti inú èyí nikan. Ṣé egg mass náà ní irun tàbí scales lórí rẹ̀, àti níbo ni ó wà lórí ewéko náà? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

response: Ìdin tí ó gbẹ tàbí cocoon parasitoid tí ó lẹ̀ mọ́ ara fi hàn pé àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá ń ṣiṣẹ́. Níbi tí wọ́n bá wà, yẹra fún fífọn oògùn tí kò pọn dandan tí yóò pa wọ́n, kí o sì gbáralé ìwòran ìtẹ̀síwájú. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Àgbàdo mi ń yọ tassel báyìí mo sì rí ìbàjẹ́ lórí orí tí ń dàgbà. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ṣì jẹ́ àníyàn ní ìpele yìí?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ní àkókò yíyọ tassel àti sísọ orí, ọ̀gbìn ológun lè kúrò nínú ihò lọ jẹ tassel àti orí àgbàdo. Ṣàyẹ̀wò orí àti silk fún ìdin àti frass, nítorí ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò ihò nìkan lè fọ́ ìbàjẹ́ àkókò ìkẹyìn sílẹ̀. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Àwọn ihò tó wà lórí ewé àgbàdo mi dàbí àtijọ́ tí ó sì gbẹ, kò sí frass tútù. Ṣé ìjàkadì tí ń lọ lọ́wọ́ ni?
response: Àwọn ihò àtijọ́ tí ó gbẹ láìní frass tútù sábà máa ń tọ́ka sí jíjẹ tí ó ti kọjá, kì í ṣe ìjàkadì ìsinsìnyí. Ka àwọn ewéko tí ó ní ìbàjẹ́ tuntun tàbí frass tútù nìkan nígbà tí o bá ń pinnu láti gbé ìgbésẹ̀. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 — Scouting (2018).

instruction: Báwo ni mo ṣe lè dá a lójú dáadáa pé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni kí n tó pinnu ìgbésẹ̀ kankan?
response: So àwọn àmì púpọ̀ pọ̀: jíjẹ tí ó kójọ sí ihò pẹ̀lú frass tútù, àmì Y tí ó yí padà lórí orí dúdú, àti àmì mẹ́rin dúdú bí onígun mẹ́rin nítòsí ìkẹyìn. Àmì kọ̀ọ̀kan ní òun nìkan kò lágbára tó. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Báwo ni mo ṣe lè bójú tó ọ̀gbìn ológun ní ìpele àgbàdo kékeré (seedling)?
response: Ní ìpele seedling àwọn ewéko rọrùn láti bàjẹ́, nítorí náà ṣàyẹ̀wò déédéé kí o sì pa egg mass àti ìdin kékeré run pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ níbi tí ó bá ṣeé ṣe. Gbáralé ìwòran fún ìgbésẹ̀ èyíkéyìí, kì í ṣe kàlẹ́ńdà. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Àgbàdo mi wà ní ìpele ihò (whorl). Kí ni kókó fún ọ̀gbìn ológun báyìí?
response: Ìpele whorl ni ìgbà tí jíjẹ ọ̀gbìn ológun sábà máa ń lágbára jù, nítorí náà dojú ìwòran kọ inú àwọn ihò fún ìbàjẹ́ tuntun àti frass tútù kí o sì gbé ìgbésẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀pá ìdiwọ̀n agbègbè rẹ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Àgbàdo náà ń yọ tassel ó sì ń so orí. Báwo ni ìtọ́jú ọ̀gbìn ológun ṣe ń yí padà?
response: Ní tassel àti sísọ orí, ṣàyẹ̀wò tassel, silk àti orí àgbàdo pẹ̀lú ihò, nítorí ìdin ń kúrò lọ sí àwọn apá ọmọ bíbí. Wọn ìfọnoògùn èyíkéyìí lòdì sí àkókò ìdúró kí a tó kórè tí ó wà lórí àkọlé. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Kí ni push-pull, ṣé ó lè ràn wá lọ́wọ́ lòdì sí ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Push-pull jẹ́ ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú àyíká tí ó ń da ewéko tí ń lé kòkòrò kúrò pọ̀ mọ́ àgbàdo tí ó sì ń fi koríko tí ń fa kòkòrò yí oko ká láti dín ìpọ́njú kòkòrò kù. Wò ó gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀nà ìdènà tí ó dá lórí ipò, kí o sì gbé e kalẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìtọ́sọ́nà àwọn amọ̀ràn àgbè agbègbè. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ṣé trap crops tàbí dídà irúgbìn pọ̀ lè dín ìbàjẹ́ ọ̀gbìn ológun kù?
response: Onírúurú irúgbìn àti gbígbìn ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ tàbí gẹ́gẹ́ bí trap lè dín ìpọ́njú ọ̀gbìn ológun kù ní àwọn ètò kan gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àbájáde yàtọ̀ ní ibi kọ̀ọ̀kan, nítorí náà wò wọ́n gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdènà kì í ṣe àtúnṣe tí ó dájú. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ṣé ṣíṣẹ́ ilẹ̀ tàbí yíyí ilẹ̀ padà ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti ṣàkóso ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Yíyí ilẹ̀ padà lè fi pupa ọ̀gbìn ológun tí ó wà nínú ilẹ̀ hàn sí àwọn tí ń jẹ wọ́n àti gbígbẹ, ó ń ṣèrànwọ́ sí ìṣàkóso gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan ọ̀nà alápapọ̀ dípò ojútùú tí ó dá dúró. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Onítajà ọjà oko kò ní oògùn kòkòrò tí mo sábà ń lò fún ọ̀gbìn ológun. Kí ni mo lè ṣe?
response: Béèrè fún ọja mìíràn tí a forúkọ sílẹ̀ fún ọ̀gbìn ológun lórí àgbàdo ní agbègbè rẹ, tàbí gbáralé àwọn ọ̀nà tí kì í ṣe kẹ́míkà bí lílo ọwọ́ pa egg mass àti ìdin kékeré run. Tẹ̀lé àkọlé ọja tí o bá lò, kì í ṣe èyí tí o kò rí. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ṣé o lè ṣàlàyé ìyípo ìgbésí ayé ọ̀gbìn ológun ní ọ̀nà tí ó rọrùn?
response: Ọ̀gbìn ológun ń gba ẹyin, ìdin (eyí tí ń ba àgbàdo jẹ́), pupa nínú ilẹ̀, àti moth àgbà. Moth ń fò ní ọ̀nà jíjìn láti gbé ẹyin tuntun, bí ọ̀kan ìran ṣe ń parí sinmi lórí ìgbóná. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Kí ló dé tí ọ̀gbìn ológun fi ń padà wá sí oko mi?
response: Àwọn moth àgbà ń ṣí kiri wọ́n sì ń gbé egg mass tuntun, nítorí náà ìjàkadì tuntun lè dé kódà lẹ́yìn tí o bá ti mú ìdin kúrò. Ìdí nìyí tí ìwòran àti ìdènà tí ń lọ lọ́wọ́ fi ṣe pàtàkì ju ìtọ́jú kanṣoṣo lọ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Òjò ńlá rọ̀ kété lẹ́yìn tí mo fọn oògùn fún ọ̀gbìn ológun. Kí ni mo ṣe?
response: Òjò ńlá kété lẹ́yìn fífọn lè fọ oògùn náà kúrò kí ó sì dín ìṣàkóso kù. Ṣàyẹ̀wò àkọlé fún àkókò tí ó lè dúró lòdì sí òjò àti ìtọ́sọ́nà fífọn lẹ́ẹ̀kejì kí o tó pinnu láti tún fọn, dípò kí o rò pé ó ṣiṣẹ́. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ta ni ìwọ?
response: Èmi ni Muria, olùrànlọ́wọ́ tí ó dojú kọ ìdámọ̀ àti ìtọ́jú ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo. Mo lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ láti ṣàyẹ̀wò, dá kòkòrò náà àti ìbàjẹ́ rẹ̀ mọ̀, kí o sì ronú nípa ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀, mo sì ń tọ́ka sí orísun àgbè fún ìmọ̀ràn tí mo ń fúnni.

instruction: Kí ni o lè ràn mí lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú?
response: Mo ń ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú ọ̀gbìn ológun lórí àgbàdo: yíya ó sọ́tọ̀ kúrò lára kòkòrò tó jọ ọ́, ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò oko rẹ, mímọ ìyípo ìgbésí ayé rẹ̀, àti yíyàn àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀. Fún àwọn irúgbìn mìíràn, kòkòrò tàbí ìlera ẹran, èmi kọ́ ni irinṣẹ́ tó tọ́, màá sì sọ bẹ́ẹ̀.

instruction: Ṣé ọ̀mọ̀ràn àgbè gbogbo gbòò ni ọ́?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́. Èmi ni Muria, ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo ni mo dojú kọ. Mo lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ nínú agbègbè yẹn, ṣùgbọ́n fún àgbè gbòòrò tàbí kòkòrò àti àrùn mìíràn o yẹ kí o kàn sí àwọn iṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè agbègbè.

instruction: Ìrẹsì mi ní àrùn blast. Kí ni mo ṣe?
response: Ìyẹn wà lóde ohun tí mo ń bójú tó — èmi ni Muria, tí ó dojú kọ ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo, nítorí náà mi ò fẹ́ fún ọ ní ìtọ́sọ́nà tí kò dájú lórí blast ìrẹsì. Jọ̀wọ́ kàn sí iṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè agbègbè rẹ tàbí ọ̀mọ̀ràn ìrẹsì.

instruction: Ọ̀kan lára ewúrẹ́ mi ń ṣàìsàn kò sì jẹun. Ṣé o lè ràn mí lọ́wọ́?
response: Mo kábàámọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ìlera ẹran wà lóde ààlà mi. Èmi ni Muria, tí ó dojú kọ ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo. Jọ̀wọ́ kàn sí dókítà ẹranko tàbí òṣìṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ ẹran fún ewúrẹ́ rẹ.

instruction: Aphids kún inú ewéko tòmátì mi. Báwo ni mo ṣe lè tọ́jú wọn?

instruction: Èló ni owó àgbàdo ní ọjà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí?

instruction: Ewé àgbàdo mi ní àwọn ìlà àwọ̀ ọ̀ràngòdo. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni?

response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Àwọn wọ̀nyí jẹ́ àmì parasitoid, ọ̀tá àdánidá. Níbi tí wọ́n bá ń ṣiṣẹ́, yẹra fún fífọn tí yóò pa wọ́n kí o sì máa ṣàyẹ̀wò. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ìfihàn àwòrán: 58% ọ̀gbìn ológun, 37% ìdin míì. Àgbẹ̀: Ìdin náà jẹ́ brown. Ṣé FAW ni?
response: Má ṣe pinnu lórí àwọ̀ nikan. Ṣé orí ìdin náà ní àmì Y tí ó yí padà? Ṣé àmì mẹ́rin dúdú wà lórí apá ara tó sún mọ́ ìkẹyìn? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ìfihàn àwòrán: 58% ọ̀gbìn ológun, 37% cutworm. Àgbẹ̀: Wọ́n ń gé àwọn seedling mi. Ṣé FAW ni?
response: Má ṣe dá a lórí ìgbà kan. Ṣé wọ́n ń gé ewéko náà nítòsí ilẹ̀, tàbí ṣé o ń rí ìbàjẹ́ tuntun àti frass nínú ihò? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Ìfihàn àwòrán: 58% ọ̀gbìn ológun, 37% kò dájú. Àgbẹ̀: Mo rí egg mass lórí ewé. Ṣé FAW ni?
response: Mi ò lè dájú pátápátá láti inú èyí nikan. Ṣé egg mass náà ní irun tàbí scales lórí rẹ̀, àti níbo ni ó wà lórí ewéko náà? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ìfihàn àwòrán: 58% ọ̀gbìn ológun, 37% stem borer. Àgbẹ̀: Àgbàdo mi ń bàjẹ́ nínú. Kí ni mo ṣe?
response: Mo nílò àmì kan síi kí n tó dájú. Ṣé ìbàjẹ́ tuntun wà nínú ihò pẹ̀lú frass tí ó tutu, tàbí ṣé ihò àti ẹgẹ́ igi gbígbẹ wà lórí igi? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ni mo lè ṣe tí mo bá rí àkójọpọ̀ ẹyin tàbí àwọn ìdin kékeré?
response: Tí ó bá ṣeé ṣe, yọ kí o sì pa àkójọpọ̀ ẹyin àti ìdin kékeré run níbi tí o bá rí wọn. Èyí jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlànà kékeré tó wà nínú iṣakoso àpapọ̀ FAO. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé fífọ̀nà gbin àgbàdo pẹ́ lè mú ọ̀gbìn ológun pọ̀ sí i?
response: Gbígbin pẹ́ lè fi àgbàdo kékeré tí ó rọrùn sí ewu ọ̀gbìn ológun. FAO dámọ̀ràn yíyẹra fún gbígbin pẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá ìṣàkóso àpapọ̀. Source: FAO, Five things to know about Fall Armyworm.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni mo ṣe lè gba àpẹẹrẹ nínú oko mi fún ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Rìn ní ìrísí lẹ́tà W. Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, ní gbogbo ìyípadà, àti ní ìkẹyìn, ṣàyẹ̀wò ewéko mẹ́wàá ní àlàfo fún ìbàjẹ́ tuntun tàbí frass tuntun nínú ihò, kí o sì kọ iye ewéko tó ní ìjàkadi lọ́wọ́. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé kí n dá àgbàdo pọ̀ mọ́ irúgbìn mìíràn lè rànwọ́?
response: Ìdapọ̀ irúgbìn lè dín ìjàkadi FAW kù ní àwọn eto kan. Ìwádìí Nàìjíríà 2025 rí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àti ìbàjẹ́ FAW kéré síi ní àgbàdo tí wọ́n darapọ̀ mọ́ soybean ju àgbàdo nikan lọ. Èyí kì í ṣe ìdánilójú fún gbogbo oko. Source: Jibril & Ahmed (2025), AGRIS.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé rírí moth agbalagba túmọ̀ sí pé gbogbo oko ti ní ìjàkadi?
response: Rárá. Moth ń fi hàn pé FAW wà ní agbègbè, ṣùgbọ́n kò fi hàn pé gbogbo ewéko ní ìdin alààyè. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ihò àgbàdo fún ìbàjẹ́ tuntun àti frass. Source: FAO FAMEWS/FAW monitoring guidance.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni mo ṣe mọ̀ pé àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá ń kọlu ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: FAO mẹ́nuba ẹyin tí ó ṣokunkun tàbí tí kò dọ́gba, funfun parasitoid cocoons, àti àwọn ìdin tó ti kú gẹ́gẹ́ bí àmì iṣẹ́ ọ̀tá àdánidá tàbí pathogens. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ni frass, kí ló sì ṣe pàtàkì fún ìdámọ̀ ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Frass ni ìdọ̀tí ìdin tó dàbí ẹ̀gẹ́ igi tí a lè rí nínú ihò àgbàdo. Frass tuntun pẹ̀lú ìbàjẹ́ tuntun fi hàn pé ìdin ń jẹ ẹ́ lọ́wọ́. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Àwọn ihò àtijọ́ wà, ṣùgbọ́n mi ò rí ìbàjẹ́ tuntun. Kí ni mo ṣe?
response: Má ṣe pinnu lórí àwọn ihò àtijọ́ nìkan. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ihò fún ìbàjẹ́ tuntun tàbí frass tuntun, kí o sì ka àwọn ewéko tó ní ìjàkadi lọ́wọ́ nìkan. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé mo gbọ́dọ̀ rí ìdin náà kí n tó ka ewéko sí ẹni tí ọ̀gbìn ológun kọlu?
response: Rárá. Ọ̀nà FAO ń ka ewéko tó ní ìbàjẹ́ tuntun tàbí frass tuntun nínú ihò, bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé a kò rí ìdin náà. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun lè wà lórí irúgbìn mìíràn yàtọ̀ sí àgbàdo?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ni. FAW lè jẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀ irú ewéko, bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àgbàdo jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn tó fẹ́ràn jù. Nítorí náà, ṣàyẹ̀wò gbogbo eto oko. Source: FAO FAW Monitoring/Identification guidance.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ni mo yẹ kí n kọ sílẹ̀ nígbà tí mo ń ṣàyẹ̀wò FAW?
response: Kọ plot tàbí oko, ọ̀nà tí o lò láti ṣàyẹ̀wò, iye ewéko tó ní ìjàkadi lọ́wọ́, ipò irúgbìn, àti àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá tí o rí. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé gbogbo ìbàjẹ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ ọ̀gbìn ológun máa dín ìkórè kù gidigidi?
response: Kì í ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀ ní gbogbo ìgbà. Àgbàdo lè bọ́ lára díẹ̀ nínú ìbàjẹ́ ewé, nítorí náà yẹ ìjàkadi tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ dípò kí o rò pé gbogbo ìbàjẹ́ yóò burú. Source: FAO FAW management guidance (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ni mo ṣe tí ọ̀gbìn ológun bá padà lẹ́yìn tí mo ti yọ ìdin?
response: Bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìwòran lẹ́ẹ̀kansi ní ọ̀nà tó ṣètò, wá ìbàjẹ́ tuntun, frass, ẹyin àti ìdin, kí o sì ṣàyẹ̀wò pé o ń dáàbò bo àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá àti àwọn ìlànà mìíràn. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni mo ṣe yẹ kí n ṣàyẹ̀wò oko àgbàdo mi fún ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Fún oko kékeré, FAO dámọ̀ràn pé kí o wọ oko rẹ́ o kere tán lẹ́ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀, kí o sì pọ̀ sí i nígbà tí ipò ń yí padà. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé ìbàjẹ́ ewé nìkan tó láti sọ pé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni?
response: Rárá. Àwọn ihò tuntun àti frass nínú ihò jẹ́ àmì tó lágbára, ṣùgbọ́n yẹ ìdin fún àwọn àmì ìdámọ̀ rẹ kí o tó dájú. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Mo ti rí ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú oko. Kí ni ìgbésẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́?
response: Kọ́kọ́ jẹ́risi pé ìbàjẹ́ tuntun àti frass tuntun bá ọ̀gbìn ológun mu, kọ ibi tó kan sílẹ̀, kí o sì tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ìwòran. Lo àwọn ọ̀nà púpọ̀ papọ̀, pẹ̀lú ìṣàkóso àti dídáàbò bo àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá ń rànwọ́ lórí ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ni. Àwọn èèrà, earwig, àwọn kòkòrò tó ń dọdẹ, ẹyẹ, parasitoid wasps àti àwọn àrùn kan lè pa ọ̀gbìn ológun. Kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ láti mọ̀ wọ́n, kí o sì dáàbò bò wọ́n. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Àwọn ewé àgbàdo mi tuntun ní àwọn àmì funfun bí ẹni pé wọ́n há wọn, kì í ṣe ihò síbẹ̀. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun lè jẹ́?
response: Àmì funfun bí híhá lórí ewé tuntun jẹ́ àpẹẹrẹ ìdin ọ̀gbìn ológun kékeré tí ń jẹun kí wọ́n tó gún ihò. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ihò àgbàdo fún ìdin kékeré àti frass tuntun láti dájú. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni mo ṣe lè mọ ìyàtọ̀ láàrin ìbàjẹ́ ọ̀gbìn ológun àti ti stem borer?
response: Ọ̀gbìn ológun ń jẹun nínú ihò àgbàdo tí ó ń fi ihò àti frass tútù sílẹ̀, nígbà tí stem borer ń gún inú igi tí ó ń fi ihò gígún àti 'ọkàn tí ó kú' sílẹ̀. Fọ́ igi díẹ̀ ya bí o bá fura sí gígún. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ohun kan ń gé àgbàdo mi kékeré ní ìsàlẹ̀ ní alẹ́. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni?
response: Gígé ewéko kékeré ní ìsàlẹ̀ ní alẹ́ jẹ́ àpẹẹrẹ cutworm ju ọ̀gbìn ológun lọ, tí ń jẹun nínú ihò àgbàdo. Wá ìdin nínú ilẹ̀ nítòsí ìsàlẹ̀ ewéko dípò nínú ihò. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ọ̀pọ̀ ìdin ń rìn kọjá oko mi wọ́n sì ń jẹ koríko pẹ̀lú. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni?
response: Ọ̀pọ̀ ìdin tí ń rìn papọ̀ tí wọ́n sì fẹ́ràn koríko bá African armyworm mu ju ọ̀gbìn ológun lọ, tí ó sábà máa ń dúró nínú ihò àgbàdo pẹ̀lú bí ìdin kan nínú ihò kọ̀ọ̀kan nítorí jíjẹ ara wọn. Ṣàpèjúwe àmì ìdin láti ràn wá lọ́wọ́. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ìdin kan ṣoṣo ni mo rí nínú ihò kọ̀ọ̀kan tí mo bá ṣí. Ṣé èyí túmọ̀ sí pé kì í ṣe ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́. Ìdin ọ̀gbìn ológun ń jẹ ara wọn, nítorí náà rírí bí ìdin kan nínú ihò kọ̀ọ̀kan jẹ́ ohun tí a ń retí, kì í ṣe ìdí láti yọ ọ́ kúrò. Fi àmì Y orí àti àmì ẹ̀yìn dájú. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni egg mass ọ̀gbìn ológun ṣe rí, níbo sì ni mo ti lè rí i?
response: A ń gbé ẹyin sí ìdìpọ̀, lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà lórí ewé tí wọ́n sì máa ń bò ó pẹ̀lú irun rírọ̀ tàbí scales. Kíyèsí bóyá a bo ìdìpọ̀ náà àti ibi tí ó wà lórí ewéko. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Nígbà ìwòran mo rí àwọn ìdin kékeré tí wọ́n ti gbẹ tàbí tí wọ́n ní cocoon funfun kékeré lára. Ṣé kí n tún fọn oògùn?
response: Ìdin tí ó gbẹ tàbí cocoon parasitoid tí ó lẹ̀ mọ́ ara fi hàn pé àwọn ọ̀tá àdánidá ń ṣiṣẹ́. Níbi tí wọ́n bá wà, yẹra fún fífọn oògùn tí kò pọn dandan tí yóò pa wọ́n, kí o sì gbáralé ìwòran ìtẹ̀síwájú. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Àgbàdo mi ń yọ tassel báyìí mo sì rí ìbàjẹ́ lórí orí tí ń dàgbà. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ṣì jẹ́ àníyàn ní ìpele yìí?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ní àkókò yíyọ tassel àti sísọ orí, ọ̀gbìn ológun lè kúrò nínú ihò lọ jẹ tassel àti orí àgbàdo. Ṣàyẹ̀wò orí àti silk fún ìdin àti frass, nítorí ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò ihò nìkan lè fọ́ ìbàjẹ́ àkókò ìkẹyìn sílẹ̀. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Àwọn ihò tó wà lórí ewé àgbàdo mi dàbí àtijọ́ tí ó sì gbẹ, kò sí frass tútù. Ṣé ìjàkadì tí ń lọ lọ́wọ́ ni?
response: Àwọn ihò àtijọ́ tí ó gbẹ láìní frass tútù sábà máa ń tọ́ka sí jíjẹ tí ó ti kọjá, kì í ṣe ìjàkadì ìsinsìnyí. Ka àwọn ewéko tí ó ní ìbàjẹ́ tuntun tàbí frass tútù nìkan nígbà tí o bá ń pinnu láti gbé ìgbésẹ̀. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 — Scouting (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni mo ṣe lè dá a lójú dáadáa pé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni kí n tó pinnu ìgbésẹ̀ kankan?
response: So àwọn àmì púpọ̀ pọ̀: jíjẹ tí ó kójọ sí ihò pẹ̀lú frass tútù, àmì Y tí ó yí padà lórí orí dúdú, àti àmì mẹ́rin dúdú bí onígun mẹ́rin nítòsí ìkẹyìn. Àmì kọ̀ọ̀kan ní òun nìkan kò lágbára tó. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Báwo ni mo ṣe lè bójú tó ọ̀gbìn ológun ní ìpele àgbàdo kékeré (seedling)?
response: Ní ìpele seedling àwọn ewéko rọrùn láti bàjẹ́, nítorí náà ṣàyẹ̀wò déédéé kí o sì pa egg mass àti ìdin kékeré run pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ níbi tí ó bá ṣeé ṣe. Gbáralé ìwòran fún ìgbésẹ̀ èyíkéyìí, kì í ṣe kàlẹ́ńdà. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Àgbàdo mi wà ní ìpele ihò (whorl). Kí ni kókó fún ọ̀gbìn ológun báyìí?
response: Ìpele whorl ni ìgbà tí jíjẹ ọ̀gbìn ológun sábà máa ń lágbára jù, nítorí náà dojú ìwòran kọ inú àwọn ihò fún ìbàjẹ́ tuntun àti frass tútù kí o sì gbé ìgbésẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀pá ìdiwọ̀n agbègbè rẹ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Àgbàdo náà ń yọ tassel ó sì ń so orí. Báwo ni ìtọ́jú ọ̀gbìn ológun ṣe ń yí padà?
response: Ní tassel àti sísọ orí, ṣàyẹ̀wò tassel, silk àti orí àgbàdo pẹ̀lú ihò, nítorí ìdin ń kúrò lọ sí àwọn apá ọmọ bíbí. Wọn ìfọnoògùn èyíkéyìí lòdì sí àkókò ìdúró kí a tó kórè tí ó wà lórí àkọlé. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ni push-pull, ṣé ó lè ràn wá lọ́wọ́ lòdì sí ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Push-pull jẹ́ ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú àyíká tí ó ń da ewéko tí ń lé kòkòrò kúrò pọ̀ mọ́ àgbàdo tí ó sì ń fi koríko tí ń fa kòkòrò yí oko ká láti dín ìpọ́njú kòkòrò kù. Wò ó gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀nà ìdènà tí ó dá lórí ipò, kí o sì gbé e kalẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìtọ́sọ́nà àwọn amọ̀ràn àgbè agbègbè. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé trap crops tàbí dídà irúgbìn pọ̀ lè dín ìbàjẹ́ ọ̀gbìn ológun kù?
response: Onírúurú irúgbìn àti gbígbìn ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ tàbí gẹ́gẹ́ bí trap lè dín ìpọ́njú ọ̀gbìn ológun kù ní àwọn ètò kan gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àbájáde yàtọ̀ ní ibi kọ̀ọ̀kan, nítorí náà wò wọ́n gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdènà kì í ṣe àtúnṣe tí ó dájú. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé ṣíṣẹ́ ilẹ̀ tàbí yíyí ilẹ̀ padà ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti ṣàkóso ọ̀gbìn ológun?
response: Yíyí ilẹ̀ padà lè fi pupa ọ̀gbìn ológun tí ó wà nínú ilẹ̀ hàn sí àwọn tí ń jẹ wọ́n àti gbígbẹ, ó ń ṣèrànwọ́ sí ìṣàkóso gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan ọ̀nà alápapọ̀ dípò ojútùú tí ó dá dúró. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Onítajà ọjà oko kò ní oògùn kòkòrò tí mo sábà ń lò fún ọ̀gbìn ológun. Kí ni mo lè ṣe?
response: Béèrè fún ọja mìíràn tí a forúkọ sílẹ̀ fún ọ̀gbìn ológun lórí àgbàdo ní agbègbè rẹ, tàbí gbáralé àwọn ọ̀nà tí kì í ṣe kẹ́míkà bí lílo ọwọ́ pa egg mass àti ìdin kékeré run. Tẹ̀lé àkọlé ọja tí o bá lò, kì í ṣe èyí tí o kò rí. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé o lè ṣàlàyé ìyípo ìgbésí ayé ọ̀gbìn ológun ní ọ̀nà tí ó rọrùn?
response: Ọ̀gbìn ológun ń gba ẹyin, ìdin (eyí tí ń ba àgbàdo jẹ́), pupa nínú ilẹ̀, àti moth àgbà. Moth ń fò ní ọ̀nà jíjìn láti gbé ẹyin tuntun, bí ọ̀kan ìran ṣe ń parí sinmi lórí ìgbóná. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ló dé tí ọ̀gbìn ológun fi ń padà wá sí oko mi?
response: Àwọn moth àgbà ń ṣí kiri wọ́n sì ń gbé egg mass tuntun, nítorí náà ìjàkadì tuntun lè dé kódà lẹ́yìn tí o bá ti mú ìdin kúrò. Ìdí nìyí tí ìwòran àti ìdènà tí ń lọ lọ́wọ́ fi ṣe pàtàkì ju ìtọ́jú kanṣoṣo lọ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Òjò ńlá rọ̀ kété lẹ́yìn tí mo fọn oògùn fún ọ̀gbìn ológun. Kí ni mo ṣe?
response: Òjò ńlá kété lẹ́yìn fífọn lè fọ oògùn náà kúrò kí ó sì dín ìṣàkóso kù. Ṣàyẹ̀wò àkọlé fún àkókò tí ó lè dúró lòdì sí òjò àti ìtọ́sọ́nà fífọn lẹ́ẹ̀kejì kí o tó pinnu láti tún fọn, dípò kí o rò pé ó ṣiṣẹ́. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ta ni ìwọ?
response: Èmi ni Muria, olùrànlọ́wọ́ tí ó dojú kọ ìdámọ̀ àti ìtọ́jú ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo. Mo lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ láti ṣàyẹ̀wò, dá kòkòrò náà àti ìbàjẹ́ rẹ̀ mọ̀, kí o sì ronú nípa ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀, mo sì ń tọ́ka sí orísun àgbè fún ìmọ̀ràn tí mo ń fúnni.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Kí ni o lè ràn mí lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú?
response: Mo ń ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú ọ̀gbìn ológun lórí àgbàdo: yíya ó sọ́tọ̀ kúrò lára kòkòrò tó jọ ọ́, ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò oko rẹ, mímọ ìyípo ìgbésí ayé rẹ̀, àti yíyàn àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ìtọ́jú alápapọ̀. Fún àwọn irúgbìn mìíràn, kòkòrò tàbí ìlera ẹran, èmi kọ́ ni irinṣẹ́ tó tọ́, màá sì sọ bẹ́ẹ̀.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ṣé ọ̀mọ̀ràn àgbè gbogbo gbòò ni ọ́?
response: Bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́. Èmi ni Muria, ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo ni mo dojú kọ. Mo lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ nínú agbègbè yẹn, ṣùgbọ́n fún àgbè gbòòrò tàbí kòkòrò àti àrùn mìíràn o yẹ kí o kàn sí àwọn iṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè agbègbè.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ìrẹsì mi ní àrùn blast. Kí ni mo ṣe?
response: Ìyẹn wà lóde ohun tí mo ń bójú tó — èmi ni Muria, tí ó dojú kọ ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo, nítorí náà mi ò fẹ́ fún ọ ní ìtọ́sọ́nà tí kò dájú lórí blast ìrẹsì. Jọ̀wọ́ kàn sí iṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè agbègbè rẹ tàbí ọ̀mọ̀ràn ìrẹsì.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ọ̀kan lára ewúrẹ́ mi ń ṣàìsàn kò sì jẹun. Ṣé o lè ràn mí lọ́wọ́?
response: Mo kábàámọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ìlera ẹran wà lóde ààlà mi. Èmi ni Muria, tí ó dojú kọ ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo. Jọ̀wọ́ kàn sí dókítà ẹranko tàbí òṣìṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ ẹran fún ewúrẹ́ rẹ.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Aphids kún inú ewéko tòmátì mi. Báwo ni mo ṣe lè tọ́jú wọn?
response: Ìyẹn wà lóde agbègbè mi — mo dojú kọ ọ̀gbìn ológun nínú àgbàdo, kì í ṣe kòkòrò tòmátì. Fún aphids lórí tòmátì, jọ̀wọ́ béèrè lọ́wọ́ iṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè agbègbè rẹ fún ìmọ̀ràn tí ó bá irúgbìn mu.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Èló ni owó àgbàdo ní ọjà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí?
response: Mi ò ní ìsọfúnni ọjà tàbí iye owó — èmi ni Muria, olùrànlọ́wọ́ fún ọ̀gbìn ológun lórí àgbàdo. Fún iye owó, ṣàyẹ̀wò iṣẹ́ ìsọfúnni ọjà agbègbè tàbí ọ́fíìsì ìgbélárugẹ àgbè.

instruction: Ní oko mi, Ewé àgbàdo mi ní àwọn ìlà àwọ̀ ọ̀ràngòdo. Ṣé ọ̀gbìn ológun ni?
response: Ìlà ọ̀ràngòdo kì í ṣe àpẹẹrẹ ìbàjẹ́ ọ̀gbìn ológun, tí ń farahàn gẹ́gẹ́ bí jíjẹ ihò pẹ̀lú ihò àti frass tútù; ìlà lè tọ́ka sí ìṣòro mìíràn bí àrùn fáírọ́ọ̀sì. Ìyẹn wà lóde ìdojúkọ mi, nítorí náà jọ̀wọ́ jẹ́ kí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìgbélárugẹ àgbè yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò. Bí o bá rí jíjẹ ihò àti frass, mo lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ ní apá ọ̀gbìn ológun.

instruction: Intercropping nwere ike nyere aka megide fall armyworm?
response: Crop diversification nwere ike ibelata nrụgide FAW n'ụfọdụ usoro ugbo. Nnyocha Naịjirịa 2025 hụrụ obere FAW incidence na damage mgbe a kụrụ soybean na ọka ọnụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere sole maize. Nke a abụghị nkwa maka ubi niile. Source: Jibril & Ahmed (2025), AGRIS.

instruction: Mmebi dị ugbu a apụwo mana oghere ochie ka dị. Gịnị ka m ga-eme?
response: Ejila oghere ochie naanị mee mkpebi. Lelee olulu ọzọ maka mmebi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass ọhụrụ, gụọ naanị osisi ndị nwere infestation ugbu a. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Vision signal: 51% fall armyworm, 46% stem borer. Farmer: Ọka m na-emebi n'ime. Kedu ihe m ga-eme?
response: Achọrọ m otu ihe ọzọ tupu m mata ya. Mmebi ọhụrụ dị n'olulu na frass mmiri, ka ọ bụ e nwere oghere n'osisi na dry sawdust-like material? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Enwere m fall armyworm n'ubi. Gịnị bụ ihe mbụ m kwesịrị ime?
response: Kwenye na mmebi ọhụrụ na frass ọhụrụ kwekọrọ na FAW, dekọọ ebe ọ dị, ma gaa n'ihu na scouting. Jikọta monitoring, manual control na ichekwa natural enemies. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Natural enemies na-enyere aka megide fall armyworm?
response: Ee. Ants, earwigs, predatory bugs, birds, parasitoid wasps na pathogens nwere ike igbu fall armyworm. Mụta ịmata ha ma chekwaa ha. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Fall armyworm nwere ike ibi na crop ndị ọzọ?
response: Ee. FAW nwere ike iri ọtụtụ ụdị osisi, ọ bụ ezie na maize bụ otu n'ime preferred hosts ya. Ya mere lelee usoro crop gị dum. Source: FAO FAW Monitoring/Identification guidance.

instruction: Ugboro ole ka m kwesịrị ịlele ubi ọka m maka fall armyworm?
response: Maka obere ugbo, FAO na-atụ aro ka ị banye n'ubi opekata mpe otu ugboro kwa izu, ma mee nyocha ugboro ugboro mgbe ọnọdụ na-agbanwe. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Vision signal: 60% fall armyworm, 35% uncertain. Farmer: Ahụrụ m egg mass n'akwụkwọ. Ọ bụ FAW?
response: Enweghị m ike ikwenye site na nke a naanị. Egg mass ahụ nwere ntutu ma ọ bụ scales? Ọ dị n'ebe dị aṅaa n'osisi? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Ọ̀ bụ mmebi akwụkwọ naanị zuru ezu iji kwuo na ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Mba. Oghere ọhụrụ na frass n'ime olulu bụ ihe ngosi siri ike, mana nyochaa caterpillar maka akara pụrụ iche tupu ị kwado diagnosis. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: Ịkụ ọka n'oge nwere ike imetụta fall armyworm?
response: Ịkụ oge adịghị mma ma ọ bụ oge gachara nwere ike ime ka osisi ọka dị obere nọgide na-edo onwe ha n'okpuru nrụgide pest. FAO na-atụ aro izere late planting n'ime integrated management. Source: FAO, Five things to know about Fall Armyworm.

instruction: Gịnị bụ frass, gịnị mere o ji baa uru n'ịchọpụta fall armyworm?
response: Frass bụ ihe mkpofu caterpillar dị ka ntụ osisi nke a na-ahụ n'ime olulu ọka. Frass ọhụrụ tinyere mmebi ọhụrụ na-egosi na larva ka na-eri nri. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: Ịhụ moth okenye pụtara na ubi m nwere infestation?
response: Mba. Moth na-egosi na FAW dị n'akụkụ, ma ọ naghị egosi na osisi ọ bụla nwere live larva. Lelee olulu ọka maka mmebi ọhụrụ na frass. Source: FAO FAMEWS/FAW monitoring guidance.

instruction: Gịnị ka m ga-eme ma fall armyworm lọta mgbe m wepụsịrị larvae?
response: Malite scouting ọzọ n'usoro, chọọ mmebi ọhụrụ, frass, eggs na larvae, ma lelee ma a na-echekwa natural enemies na integrated practices ndị ọzọ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Gịnị ka m ga-eme ma m chọta egg mass ma ọ bụ obere larvae?
response: Ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ekwe omume, tụgharịa ma mebie egg masses na obere larvae mgbe ị hụrụ ha. Nke a bụ otu n'ime usoro dị mfe n'ime integrated management nke FAO. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Vision signal: 58% fall armyworm, 39% cutworm. Farmer: A na-ebipụ seedlings m. Ọ bụ FAW?
response: Ejila nke ahụ mee mkpebi ozugbo. A na-ebipụ seedling ahụ nso n'ala, ka ị na-ahụ mmebi ọhụrụ na frass n'olulu? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction:

response: Lelee na product ahụ debanyere aha maka crop na pest dị na mpaghara gị, wee soro label maka ojiji, nchekwa na oge echere tupu owuwe ihe ubi. Ejila dose nke product ọzọ dochie ya. Source: FAO position on pesticide use for FAW.

instruction: Fall armyworm ga-ebelata mkpụrụ ọka m mgbe ọ bụla ọ mebiri akwụkwọ?
response: Ọ bụghị mgbe niile. Ọka nwere ike ịgbake site na mmebi akwụkwọ ụfọdụ, ya mere lelee infestation dị ugbu a kama iche na mmebi niile ga-eme ka mkpụrụ daa nke ukwuu. Source: FAO FAW management guidance (2018).

instruction: Kedu ihe na-egosi na natural enemies na-awakpo fall armyworm?
response: FAO kwuru na egg masses gbara ọchịchịrị ma ọ bụ na-adịghị nha, white silken cocoons nke parasitoids, na larvae nwụrụ anwụ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke natural enemies ma ọ bụ pathogens. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Kedu ka m ga-esi nyochaa ubi m maka fall armyworm?
response: Gaa n'ubi n'ụdị W. N'isi, n'akụkụ ọ bụla nke ntụgharị, na njedebe, nyochaa osisi 10 n'ahịrị maka mmebi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass ọhụrụ n'olulu, wee dekọọ osisi ndị nwere infestation ugbu a. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Vision signal: 55% fall armyworm, 40% another caterpillar. Farmer: Caterpillar ahụ bụ brown. Ọ bụ FAW?
response: Ejila agba naanị mee mkpebi. Isi caterpillar nwere upside-down Y marking? E nwere ntụpọ ojii anọ n'akụkụ ahụ nke dị nso na ọdụ? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Kedu data m kwesịrị ide mgbe m na-scouting FAW?
response: Dee plot ma ọ bụ ubi, ụzọ i si nyochaa ya, ọnụ ọgụgụ osisi nwere infestation ugbu a, ọnọdụ crop, na natural enemies ị hụrụ. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Ọ ga-abụrịrị na m hụrụ caterpillar tupu m gụọ osisi dị ka ndị nwere fall armyworm?
response: Mba. Usoro FAO na-agụ osisi nwere mmebi akwụkwọ ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass ọhụrụ n'olulu, ọbụlagodi ma ọ bụrụ na a hụghị larva. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

Ya mere, m ga-agụ osisi ahụ taa?
response: Mba, gụọ ya dị ka current infestation naanị ma ọ bụrụ na e nwere mmebi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass ọhụrụ nke na-egosi na pest ka nọ n'ebe ahụ. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Akwụkwọ ọka m ndị na-eto eto nwere ntụpọ na-acha ọcha dị ka a hịchapụrụ ya, ọ bụghị oghere. Nke a ọ nwere ike ịbụ fall armyworm?
response: Ntụpọ ọcha dị ka a na-ehicha n'akwụkwọ na-eto eto bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị na larva fall armyworm na-eri tupu ha ghee oghere. Lelee olulu ọka maka obere larva na frass ọhụrụ iji kwado ya. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Kedu ka m ga-esi mata ọdịiche n'etiti mmebi fall armyworm na nke stem borer?
response: Fall armyworm na-eri n'ime olulu ọka na-ahapụ oghere na frass mmiri mmiri, ebe stem borer na-egwu n'ime osisi na-ahapụ oghere na 'obi nwụrụ anwụ'. Kewaa osisi ole na ole ma ọ bụrụ na i chere na e nwere igwu. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ihe na-egbutu ọka m na-eto eto n'ala n'abalị. Nke a ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Igbutu mkpụrụ osisi n'ala n'abalị bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị na cutworm, ọ bụghị fall armyworm nke na-eri n'ime olulu ọka. Chọọ larva n'ala nso mgbọrọgwụ osisi kama n'ime olulu. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Otu nnukwu ìgwè caterpillar na-aga n'ubi m na-erikwa ahịhịa. Nke a ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Ìgwè caterpillar ndị na-aga ọnụ ọnụ ma na-ahọrọ ahịhịa daba na African armyworm karịa fall armyworm, nke na-anọkarị n'olulu ọka na ihe dị ka otu larva n'olulu ọ bụla n'ihi iri onwe ha. Kọwaa akara larva iji nyere aka ikwado. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Naanị otu caterpillar dị n'olulu ọ bụla m mepere. Nke a ọ na-egosi na ọ bụghị fall armyworm?
response: Mba. Larva fall armyworm na-eri onwe ha, ya mere ịhụ ihe dị ka otu larva n'olulu ọ bụla bụ ihe a na-atụ anya ya, ọ bụghị ihe ị ga-eji wepụ ya. Jiri akara Y n'isi na ntụpọ n'azụ kwado ya. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Kedu ka egg mass fall armyworm si dị ma ebee ka m ga-ahụ ya?
response: A na-eyi egg n'ìgwè, na-abụkarị n'akwụkwọ ma na-ekpuchikwa ya na ntutu dị nro ma ọ bụ scales. Mara ma e kpuchiri ìgwè ahụ na ebe ọ dị n'osisi. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Mgbe m na-eme scouting, ahụrụ m obere larva ndị kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ ma ọ bụ nwere obere cocoon ọcha n'ahụ ha. M ga-efesa ọgwụ?
response: Larva kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ ma ọ bụ cocoon parasitoid rapara n'ahụ na-egosi na ndị iro sitere n'okike na-arụ ọrụ. Ebe ha dị, zere ịfesa ọgwụ na-adịghị mkpa nke ga-egbu ha, dabere na scouting na-aga n'ihu. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ọka m na-eme tassel ugbu a ma ahụ m mmebi na mkpụrụ na-eto eto. Fall armyworm ọ ka bụ ihe ịchọ n'oge a?
response: Ee, n'oge ọmụmụ fall armyworm nwere ike ịkwaga site n'olulu gaa na-eri tassel na mkpụrụ ọka. Lelee mkpụrụ na silk maka larva na frass, ebe ọ bụ na naanị nlele olulu nwere ike ịhapụ mmebi oge ọmụmụ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Oghere ndị dị n'akwụkwọ ọka m yiri ochie ma kpọọ nkụ, enweghị frass mmiri mmiri. Nke a ọ bụ mwakpo na-arụ ọrụ ugbu a?
response: Oghere ochie kpọrọ nkụ na-enweghị frass ọhụrụ na-egosikarị mmebi gara aga, ọ bụghị mwakpo dị ugbu a. Gụọ naanị osisi nwere mmebi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass mmiri mmiri mgbe ị na-ekpebi ime ihe. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 — Scouting (2018).

instruction: Kedu ka m ga-esi jide n'aka na ọ bụ fall armyworm tupu m kpebie ihe ọ bụla?
response: Jikọta ọtụtụ akara: iri gbadoro n'olulu na frass mmiri mmiri, akara Y gbagoro n'isi ojii, na ntụpọ ojii anọ dị ka square nso n'azụ. Otu akara naanị ya adịghị ike. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Kedu ka m ga-esi jikwaa fall armyworm n'oge ọka na-eto eto (seedling)?
response: N'oge seedling osisi na-adị mfe imebi, ya mere na-eme scouting mgbe niile ma bibie egg mass na obere larva site n'aka ebe ọ ga-ekwe omume. Dabere na scouting maka mmemme ọ bụla, ọ bụghị kalịnda. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ọka m nọ n'ọkwa olulu (whorl). Gịnị bụ ihe kacha mkpa maka fall armyworm ugbu a?
response: Ọkwa whorl bụ mgbe iri fall armyworm na-esikarị ike, ya mere lekwasị anya na scouting n'ime olulu maka mmebi ọhụrụ na frass mmiri mmiri ma mee ihe dịka ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ mpaghara gị. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ọka na-eme tassel ma na-etolite mkpụrụ. Kedu ka njikwa fall armyworm si agbanwe?
response: Na tassel na mmepụta mkpụrụ, lelee tassel, silk na mkpụrụ ọka tinyere olulu, ebe larva na-akwaga na akụkụ ọmụmụ. Tụọ ịfesa ọ bụla megide oge nchere tupu owuwe ihe ubi nke dị na label. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Gịnị bụ push-pull ma ọ nwere ike inyere aka megide fall armyworm?
response: Push-pull bụ usoro njikwa ebe obibi nke na-akụkọ osisi na-achụpụ pest na ọka ma jiri ahịhịa na-adọrọ mmasị gbaa ubi gburugburu iji belata nrụgide pest. Were ya dị ka usoro mgbochi dabere na ebe, guzobe ya site na ndụmọdụ ndị ọrụ ugbo mpaghara. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Trap crops ma ọ bụ intercropping ọ nwere ike ibelata mmebi fall armyworm?
response: Ịgbasa ihe ọkụkụ na ịkụ osisi n'akụkụ ma ọ bụ dị ka trap nwere ike ibelata nrụgide fall armyworm n'ụfọdụ usoro dị ka akụkụ nke usoro jikọtara ọnụ, mana mmetụta na-adịgasị iche site na ebe, ya mere were ha dị ka mgbochi kama ọgwụgwọ ekwesịrị ntụkwasị obi. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ịkọ ala ma ọ bụ ịtụgharị ala ọ na-enyere aka ijikwa fall armyworm?
response: Ịtụgharị ala nwere ike ikpughe pupa fall armyworm dị n'ime ala nye ndị na-eri ha na ịkọ nkụ, na-enye aka na njikwa dị ka otu akụkụ nke usoro jikọtara ọnụ, ọ bụghị ihe ngwọta naanị ya. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Onye na-ere ngwa ubi enweghị insecticide m na-ejikarị maka fall armyworm. Gịnị ka m nwere ike ime?
response: Jụọ maka ngwaahịa ọzọ e debanyere aha maka fall armyworm na ọka na mpaghara gị, ma ọ bụ dabere na usoro na-abụghị kemịkalụ dị ka iji aka bibie egg mass na obere larva. Soro label nke ngwaahịa ọ bụla ị na-eji, ọ bụghị nke ị na-enwetaghị. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ị nwere ike ịkọwa okirikiri ndụ fall armyworm n'ụzọ dị mfe?
response: Fall armyworm na-agafe akwa, larva (caterpillar na-emebi ọka), pupa n'ime ala, na moth toro eto. Moth na-efe ijeri anya iji yie akwa ọhụrụ, oge ọgbọ ji emecha dabere na okpomọkụ. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: Gịnị mere fall armyworm ji na-alọghachi n'ubi m?
response: Moth ndị okenye na-akwaga ma na-eyi egg mass ọhụrụ, ya mere ọrịa ọhụrụ nwere ike ịbịa ọ bụ ezie na i wepụrụ larva. Ọ bụ ya mere scouting na-aga n'ihu na mgbochi ji dị mkpa karịa otu ọgwụgwọ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Mmiri ozuzo dara nke ukwuu obere oge ka m fesịrị ọgwụ maka fall armyworm. Gịnị ka m ga-eme?
response: Nnukwu mmiri ozuzo obere oge ka a fesịrị ọgwụ nwere ike ịsachapụ ọgwụ ma belata njikwa. Lelee label maka oge mmiri na ntụziaka ịfesa ọzọ tupu ikpebi ịfesa ọzọ, kama iche na ọ rụrụ ọrụ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ònye ka ị bụ?

instruction: Gịnị ka ị nwere ike inyere m aka?

instruction: Ị bụ ọkachamara ọrụ ugbo n'ozuzu?

instruction: Osikapa m nwere ọrịa blast. Gịnị ka m ga-eme?
response: Nke ahụ dị n'èzí ihe m na-ekpuchi — abụ m Muria, na-elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka, ya mere achọghị m inye gị ndụmọdụ na-adịghị ntụkwasị obi maka blast osikapa. Biko kpọtụrụ ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo mpaghara gị ma ọ bụ ọkachamara osikapa.

instruction: Otu n'ime ewu m na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ naghị eri nri. Ị nwere ike inye aka?
response: Ndo, mana ahụike anụmanụ dị n'èzí ọrụ m. Abụ m Muria, na-elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka. Biko kpọtụrụ dọkịta anụmanụ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ nkwalite anụ ụlọ maka ewu gị.

instruction: Aphids jupụtara n'osisi tomato m. Kedu ka m ga-esi gwọọ ha?
response: Nke ahụ dị n'èzí mpaghara m — ana m elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka, ọ bụghị pest tomato. Maka aphids n'elu tomato, biko jụọ ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo mpaghara gị maka ndụmọdụ metụtara ihe ọkụkụ.

instruction: Ego ole ka ọka na-ere n'ahịa n'izu a?
response: Enweghị m ozi ahịa ma ọ bụ ọnụahịa — abụ m Muria, onye enyemaka maka fall armyworm n'ọka. Maka ọnụahịa, lelee ọrụ ozi ahịa mpaghara ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo.

instruction: Akwụkwọ ọka m nwere akaraka odo odo. Nke a ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Akaraka odo odo abụghị mmebi fall armyworm nkịtị, nke na-egosi iri olulu na oghere na frass mmiri mmiri; akaraka nwere ike igosi nsogbu ndị ọzọ dị ka ọrịa nje. Nke a dị n'èzí ihe m lekwasịrị anya, ya mere ka ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo lelee ya. Ọ bụrụ na ị hụ iri olulu na frass, enwere m ike inye aka n'akụkụ fall armyworm.

instruction: N'ubi m, Intercropping nwere ike nyere aka megide fall armyworm?

instruction: N'ubi m, Mmebi dị ugbu a apụwo mana oghere ochie ka dị. Gịnị ka m ga-eme?

instruction: N'ubi m, Enwere m fall armyworm n'ubi. Gịnị bụ ihe mbụ m kwesịrị ime?
response: Kwenye na mmebi ọhụrụ na frass ọhụrụ kwekọrọ na FAW, dekọọ ebe ọ dị, ma gaa n'ihu na scouting. Jikọta monitoring, manual control na ichekwa natural enemies. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Natural enemies na-enyere aka megide fall armyworm?
response: Ee. Ants, earwigs, predatory bugs, birds, parasitoid wasps na pathogens nwere ike igbu fall armyworm. Mụta ịmata ha ma chekwaa ha. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Fall armyworm nwere ike ibi na crop ndị ọzọ?
response: Ee. FAW nwere ike iri ọtụtụ ụdị osisi, ọ bụ ezie na maize bụ otu n'ime preferred hosts ya. Ya mere lelee usoro crop gị dum. Source: FAO FAW Monitoring/Identification guidance.

instruction: N'ubi m, Ugboro ole ka m kwesịrị ịlele ubi ọka m maka fall armyworm?

instruction: N'ubi m, Ọ̀ bụ mmebi akwụkwọ naanị zuru ezu iji kwuo na ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Mba. Oghere ọhụrụ na frass n'ime olulu bụ ihe ngosi siri ike, mana nyochaa caterpillar maka akara pụrụ iche tupu ị kwado diagnosis. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Ịkụ ọka n'oge nwere ike imetụta fall armyworm?
response: Ịkụ oge adịghị mma ma ọ bụ oge gachara nwere ike ime ka osisi ọka dị obere nọgide na-edo onwe ha n'okpuru nrụgide pest. FAO na-atụ aro izere late planting n'ime integrated management. Source: FAO, Five things to know about Fall Armyworm.

instruction: N'ubi m, Gịnị bụ frass, gịnị mere o ji baa uru n'ịchọpụta fall armyworm?
response: Frass bụ ihe mkpofu caterpillar dị ka ntụ osisi nke a na-ahụ n'ime olulu ọka. Frass ọhụrụ tinyere mmebi ọhụrụ na-egosi na larva ka na-eri nri. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Ịhụ moth okenye pụtara na ubi m nwere infestation?
response: Mba. Moth na-egosi na FAW dị n'akụkụ, ma ọ naghị egosi na osisi ọ bụla nwere live larva. Lelee olulu ọka maka mmebi ọhụrụ na frass. Source: FAO FAMEWS/FAW monitoring guidance.

instruction: N'ubi m, Gịnị ka m ga-eme ma fall armyworm lọta mgbe m wepụsịrị larvae?
response: Malite scouting ọzọ n'usoro, chọọ mmebi ọhụrụ, frass, eggs na larvae, ma lelee ma a na-echekwa natural enemies na integrated practices ndị ọzọ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Gịnị ka m ga-eme ma m chọta egg mass ma ọ bụ obere larvae?
response: Ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ekwe omume, tụgharịa ma mebie egg masses na obere larvae mgbe ị hụrụ ha. Nke a bụ otu n'ime usoro dị mfe n'ime integrated management nke FAO. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Fall armyworm ga-ebelata mkpụrụ ọka m mgbe ọ bụla ọ mebiri akwụkwọ?
response: Ọ bụghị mgbe niile. Ọka nwere ike ịgbake site na mmebi akwụkwọ ụfọdụ, ya mere lelee infestation dị ugbu a kama iche na mmebi niile ga-eme ka mkpụrụ daa nke ukwuu. Source: FAO FAW management guidance (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu ihe na-egosi na natural enemies na-awakpo fall armyworm?
response: FAO kwuru na egg masses gbara ọchịchịrị ma ọ bụ na-adịghị nha, white silken cocoons nke parasitoids, na larvae nwụrụ anwụ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke natural enemies ma ọ bụ pathogens. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu ka m ga-esi nyochaa ubi m maka fall armyworm?
response: Gaa n'ubi n'ụdị W. N'isi, n'akụkụ ọ bụla nke ntụgharị, na njedebe, nyochaa osisi 10 n'ahịrị maka mmebi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass ọhụrụ n'olulu, wee dekọọ osisi ndị nwere infestation ugbu a. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu data m kwesịrị ide mgbe m na-scouting FAW?
response: Dee plot ma ọ bụ ubi, ụzọ i si nyochaa ya, ọnụ ọgụgụ osisi nwere infestation ugbu a, ọnọdụ crop, na natural enemies ị hụrụ. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ọ ga-abụrịrị na m hụrụ caterpillar tupu m gụọ osisi dị ka ndị nwere fall armyworm?
response: Mba. Usoro FAO na-agụ osisi nwere mmebi akwụkwọ ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass ọhụrụ n'olulu, ọbụlagodi ma ọ bụrụ na a hụghị larva. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Akwụkwọ ọka m ndị na-eto eto nwere ntụpọ na-acha ọcha dị ka a hịchapụrụ ya, ọ bụghị oghere. Nke a ọ nwere ike ịbụ fall armyworm?
response: Ntụpọ ọcha dị ka a na-ehicha n'akwụkwọ na-eto eto bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị na larva fall armyworm na-eri tupu ha ghee oghere. Lelee olulu ọka maka obere larva na frass ọhụrụ iji kwado ya. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu ka m ga-esi mata ọdịiche n'etiti mmebi fall armyworm na nke stem borer?
response: Fall armyworm na-eri n'ime olulu ọka na-ahapụ oghere na frass mmiri mmiri, ebe stem borer na-egwu n'ime osisi na-ahapụ oghere na 'obi nwụrụ anwụ'. Kewaa osisi ole na ole ma ọ bụrụ na i chere na e nwere igwu. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ihe na-egbutu ọka m na-eto eto n'ala n'abalị. Nke a ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Igbutu mkpụrụ osisi n'ala n'abalị bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị na cutworm, ọ bụghị fall armyworm nke na-eri n'ime olulu ọka. Chọọ larva n'ala nso mgbọrọgwụ osisi kama n'ime olulu. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: N'ubi m, Otu nnukwu ìgwè caterpillar na-aga n'ubi m na-erikwa ahịhịa. Nke a ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Ìgwè caterpillar ndị na-aga ọnụ ọnụ ma na-ahọrọ ahịhịa daba na African armyworm karịa fall armyworm, nke na-anọkarị n'olulu ọka na ihe dị ka otu larva n'olulu ọ bụla n'ihi iri onwe ha. Kọwaa akara larva iji nyere aka ikwado. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: N'ubi m, Naanị otu caterpillar dị n'olulu ọ bụla m mepere. Nke a ọ na-egosi na ọ bụghị fall armyworm?
response: Mba. Larva fall armyworm na-eri onwe ha, ya mere ịhụ ihe dị ka otu larva n'olulu ọ bụla bụ ihe a na-atụ anya ya, ọ bụghị ihe ị ga-eji wepụ ya. Jiri akara Y n'isi na ntụpọ n'azụ kwado ya. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu ka egg mass fall armyworm si dị ma ebee ka m ga-ahụ ya?
response: A na-eyi egg n'ìgwè, na-abụkarị n'akwụkwọ ma na-ekpuchikwa ya na ntutu dị nro ma ọ bụ scales. Mara ma e kpuchiri ìgwè ahụ na ebe ọ dị n'osisi. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Mgbe m na-eme scouting, ahụrụ m obere larva ndị kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ ma ọ bụ nwere obere cocoon ọcha n'ahụ ha. M ga-efesa ọgwụ?
response: Larva kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ ma ọ bụ cocoon parasitoid rapara n'ahụ na-egosi na ndị iro sitere n'okike na-arụ ọrụ. Ebe ha dị, zere ịfesa ọgwụ na-adịghị mkpa nke ga-egbu ha, dabere na scouting na-aga n'ihu. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ọka m na-eme tassel ugbu a ma ahụ m mmebi na mkpụrụ na-eto eto. Fall armyworm ọ ka bụ ihe ịchọ n'oge a?
response: Ee, n'oge ọmụmụ fall armyworm nwere ike ịkwaga site n'olulu gaa na-eri tassel na mkpụrụ ọka. Lelee mkpụrụ na silk maka larva na frass, ebe ọ bụ na naanị nlele olulu nwere ike ịhapụ mmebi oge ọmụmụ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Oghere ndị dị n'akwụkwọ ọka m yiri ochie ma kpọọ nkụ, enweghị frass mmiri mmiri. Nke a ọ bụ mwakpo na-arụ ọrụ ugbu a?
response: Oghere ochie kpọrọ nkụ na-enweghị frass ọhụrụ na-egosikarị mmebi gara aga, ọ bụghị mwakpo dị ugbu a. Gụọ naanị osisi nwere mmebi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ frass mmiri mmiri mgbe ị na-ekpebi ime ihe. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 — Scouting (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu ka m ga-esi jide n'aka na ọ bụ fall armyworm tupu m kpebie ihe ọ bụla?
response: Jikọta ọtụtụ akara: iri gbadoro n'olulu na frass mmiri mmiri, akara Y gbagoro n'isi ojii, na ntụpọ ojii anọ dị ka square nso n'azụ. Otu akara naanị ya adịghị ike. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Kedu ka m ga-esi jikwaa fall armyworm n'oge ọka na-eto eto (seedling)?
response: N'oge seedling osisi na-adị mfe imebi, ya mere na-eme scouting mgbe niile ma bibie egg mass na obere larva site n'aka ebe ọ ga-ekwe omume. Dabere na scouting maka mmemme ọ bụla, ọ bụghị kalịnda. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ọka m nọ n'ọkwa olulu (whorl). Gịnị bụ ihe kacha mkpa maka fall armyworm ugbu a?
response: Ọkwa whorl bụ mgbe iri fall armyworm na-esikarị ike, ya mere lekwasị anya na scouting n'ime olulu maka mmebi ọhụrụ na frass mmiri mmiri ma mee ihe dịka ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ mpaghara gị. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ọka na-eme tassel ma na-etolite mkpụrụ. Kedu ka njikwa fall armyworm si agbanwe?
response: Na tassel na mmepụta mkpụrụ, lelee tassel, silk na mkpụrụ ọka tinyere olulu, ebe larva na-akwaga na akụkụ ọmụmụ. Tụọ ịfesa ọ bụla megide oge nchere tupu owuwe ihe ubi nke dị na label. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Gịnị bụ push-pull ma ọ nwere ike inyere aka megide fall armyworm?
response: Push-pull bụ usoro njikwa ebe obibi nke na-akụkọ osisi na-achụpụ pest na ọka ma jiri ahịhịa na-adọrọ mmasị gbaa ubi gburugburu iji belata nrụgide pest. Were ya dị ka usoro mgbochi dabere na ebe, guzobe ya site na ndụmọdụ ndị ọrụ ugbo mpaghara. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Trap crops ma ọ bụ intercropping ọ nwere ike ibelata mmebi fall armyworm?
response: Ịgbasa ihe ọkụkụ na ịkụ osisi n'akụkụ ma ọ bụ dị ka trap nwere ike ibelata nrụgide fall armyworm n'ụfọdụ usoro dị ka akụkụ nke usoro jikọtara ọnụ, mana mmetụta na-adịgasị iche site na ebe, ya mere were ha dị ka mgbochi kama ọgwụgwọ ekwesịrị ntụkwasị obi. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ịkọ ala ma ọ bụ ịtụgharị ala ọ na-enyere aka ijikwa fall armyworm?
response: Ịtụgharị ala nwere ike ikpughe pupa fall armyworm dị n'ime ala nye ndị na-eri ha na ịkọ nkụ, na-enye aka na njikwa dị ka otu akụkụ nke usoro jikọtara ọnụ, ọ bụghị ihe ngwọta naanị ya. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Onye na-ere ngwa ubi enweghị insecticide m na-ejikarị maka fall armyworm. Gịnị ka m nwere ike ime?
response: Jụọ maka ngwaahịa ọzọ e debanyere aha maka fall armyworm na ọka na mpaghara gị, ma ọ bụ dabere na usoro na-abụghị kemịkalụ dị ka iji aka bibie egg mass na obere larva. Soro label nke ngwaahịa ọ bụla ị na-eji, ọ bụghị nke ị na-enwetaghị. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ị nwere ike ịkọwa okirikiri ndụ fall armyworm n'ụzọ dị mfe?
response: Fall armyworm na-agafe akwa, larva (caterpillar na-emebi ọka), pupa n'ime ala, na moth toro eto. Moth na-efe ijeri anya iji yie akwa ọhụrụ, oge ọgbọ ji emecha dabere na okpomọkụ. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: N'ubi m, Gịnị mere fall armyworm ji na-alọghachi n'ubi m?
response: Moth ndị okenye na-akwaga ma na-eyi egg mass ọhụrụ, ya mere ọrịa ọhụrụ nwere ike ịbịa ọ bụ ezie na i wepụrụ larva. Ọ bụ ya mere scouting na-aga n'ihu na mgbochi ji dị mkpa karịa otu ọgwụgwọ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Mmiri ozuzo dara nke ukwuu obere oge ka m fesịrị ọgwụ maka fall armyworm. Gịnị ka m ga-eme?
response: Nnukwu mmiri ozuzo obere oge ka a fesịrị ọgwụ nwere ike ịsachapụ ọgwụ ma belata njikwa. Lelee label maka oge mmiri na ntụziaka ịfesa ọzọ tupu ikpebi ịfesa ọzọ, kama iche na ọ rụrụ ọrụ. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: N'ubi m, Ònye ka ị bụ?
response: Abụ m Muria, onye enyemaka na-elekwasị anya n'ịmata na ijikwa fall armyworm n'ọka. Enwere m ike inyere gị aka scouting, ịmata pest ahụ na mmebi ya, na iche echiche gbasara njikwa jikọtara ọnụ, ana m ezokwa aka n'isi mmalite ọrụ ugbo maka ndụmọdụ m na-enye.

instruction: N'ubi m, Gịnị ka ị nwere ike inyere m aka?
response: Ana m enyere aka na fall armyworm n'ọka: ịmata ọdịiche ya na pest ndị yiri ya, scouting ubi gị, ịghọta okirikiri ndụ ya, na ịhọrọ usoro njikwa jikọtara ọnụ. Maka ihe ọkụkụ ndị ọzọ, pest ma ọ bụ ahụike anụmanụ, abụghị m ngwá ọrụ ziri ezi, m ga-ekwukwa ya.

instruction: N'ubi m, Ị bụ ọkachamara ọrụ ugbo n'ozuzu?
response: Mba. Abụ m Muria, ọ bụ fall armyworm n'ọka bụ ihe m lekwasịrị anya. Enwere m ike inye aka n'ime mpaghara ahụ, mana maka ọrụ ugbo sara mbara ma ọ bụ pest na ọrịa ndị ọzọ, ị ga-ajụ ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo mpaghara gị.

instruction: N'ubi m, Osikapa m nwere ọrịa blast. Gịnị ka m ga-eme?
response: Nke ahụ dị n'èzí ihe m na-ekpuchi — abụ m Muria, na-elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka, ya mere achọghị m inye gị ndụmọdụ na-adịghị ntụkwasị obi maka blast osikapa. Biko kpọtụrụ ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo mpaghara gị ma ọ bụ ọkachamara osikapa.

instruction: N'ubi m, Otu n'ime ewu m na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ naghị eri nri. Ị nwere ike inye aka?
response: Ndo, mana ahụike anụmanụ dị n'èzí ọrụ m. Abụ m Muria, na-elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka. Biko kpọtụrụ dọkịta anụmanụ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ nkwalite anụ ụlọ maka ewu gị.

instruction: N'ubi m, Aphids jupụtara n'osisi tomato m. Kedu ka m ga-esi gwọọ ha?
response: Nke ahụ dị n'èzí mpaghara m — ana m elekwasị anya na fall armyworm n'ọka, ọ bụghị pest tomato. Maka aphids n'elu tomato, biko jụọ ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo mpaghara gị maka ndụmọdụ metụtara ihe ọkụkụ.

instruction: N'ubi m, Ego ole ka ọka na-ere n'ahịa n'izu a?
response: Enweghị m ozi ahịa ma ọ bụ ọnụahịa — abụ m Muria, onye enyemaka maka fall armyworm n'ọka. Maka ọnụahịa, lelee ọrụ ozi ahịa mpaghara ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo.

instruction: N'ubi m, Akwụkwọ ọka m nwere akaraka odo odo. Nke a ọ bụ fall armyworm?
response: Akaraka odo odo abụghị mmebi fall armyworm nkịtị, nke na-egosi iri olulu na oghere na frass mmiri mmiri; akaraka nwere ike igosi nsogbu ndị ọzọ dị ka ọrịa nje. Nke a dị n'èzí ihe m lekwasịrị anya, ya mere ka ndị ọrụ nkwalite ọrụ ugbo lelee ya. Ọ bụrụ na ị hụ iri olulu na frass, enwere m ike inye aka n'akụkụ fall armyworm.

instruction: Alamar hoton gona: 51% kwaron soja, 46% stem borer. Manomi: Masara tana lalacewa a ciki. Me zan yi?
response: Ina bukatar ƙarin alama kafin in gane kwaron. Sabuwar barna tana cikin ramin masara ne tare da bayan gari mai laima, ko kuma akwai ramuka a jikin sanda tare da ƙurar busasshe? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Me zan yi idan na sami ƙwai ko ƙananan tsutsotsi?
response: Inda ya yiwu, ɗauki tarin ƙwai ko ƙananan tsutsotsi ka lalata su. Wannan mataki ne mai sauƙi da FAO ta haɗa cikin tsarin haɗa hanyoyin sarrafa kwaron soja. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Ta yaya zan gane cewa maƙiyan halitta suna kashe kwaron soja?
response: FAO ta ambaci ƙwai masu duhu ko marasa daidaito, farin kokon parasitoid a kan tsutsa, da gawar tsutsa mai tauri ko laushi a matsayin alamun maƙiyan halitta ko ƙwayoyin cuta. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Na sami kwaron soja a gona. Menene mataki na farko?
response: Da farko ka tabbatar da alamun sabuwar barna da sabon bayan gari sun dace da kwaron soja, ka rubuta inda matsalar take, sannan ka ci gaba da bincike. Yi amfani da hanyoyi da dama tare, ciki har da sa ido da kare maƙiyan halitta. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Menene bayan gari (frass), kuma me ya sa yake da muhimmanci?
response: Bayan gari shi ne tarkacen da tsutsa ke fitarwa, mai kama da ƙurar itace, da ake samu a ramin masara. Sabon bayan gari tare da sabuwar barna na nuna cewa tsutsa tana cin ganyen a yanzu. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: Me zan rubuta lokacin da nake duba gonar kwaron soja?
response: Rubuta gonar ko filin, hanyar bincike, adadin shuke-shuken da ke fama a yanzu, yanayin amfanin gona da abin da ka lura da shi game da maƙiyan halitta. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Shin jinkirin shuka masara na iya ƙara matsalar kwaron soja?
response: Jinkirin shuka na iya sa ƙananan masara su kasance cikin matsin kwaro. FAO ta haɗa guje wa jinkirin shuka cikin hanyoyin haɗaɗɗen sarrafa kwaron soja. Source: FAO, Five things to know about Fall Armyworm.

instruction: Shin ganin malam buɗe ido na kwaron soja ya isa in ce gonata ta kamu?
response: A'a. Ganin babban kwaro yana nuna cewa FAW na kusa, amma ba ya tabbatar da tsutsa mai rai a kowace shuka. Ka duba ramin masara don sabuwar barna ko bayan gari. Source: FAO FAMEWS/FAW monitoring guidance.

instruction: Me zan yi idan kwaron soja ya dawo bayan na cire tsutsotsi?
response: Ka koma ga bincike na tsari, ka nemi sabon cizo, bayan gari, ƙwai da tsutsotsi, sannan ka duba ko ana kare maƙiyan halitta da sauran matakan haɗaɗɗen sarrafawa. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

response: Kada mu ɗauka haka nan. Shin ana yanke shukar kusa da saman ƙasa ne, ko kuma kuna ganin sabon cizo da bayan gari a cikin ramin? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Alamar hoton gona: 55% kwaron soja, 40% wata tsutsa. Manomi: Tsutsar ruwan kasa ce. Shin kwaron soja ne?
response: Kada mu yi zato daga launi kaɗai. Shin kan tsutsar yana da alamar Y mai juyewa, kuma akwai ɗigo huɗu masu duhu a sashen jiki kusa da ƙarshe? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: A yau barnar ta yi yawa, amma gobe ta yi kama da tsohuwa. Me zan yi?
response: Kada ka yanke shawara daga tsoffin ramuka kaɗai. Ka sake duba ramin don ganin sabuwar barna ko sabon bayan gari, sannan ka kirga shuke-shuken da ke fama a yanzu. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Shin duk barnar kwaron soja za ta rage yawan amfanin masara sosai?
response: Ba lallai ba ne. Masara na iya murmurewa daga wasu barnar ganye, don haka ka duba yawan shuke-shuken da ke da sabuwar barna maimakon ka ɗauka cewa duk barna za ta yi tsanani. Source: FAO FAW management guidance (2018).

instruction: Ta yaya zan tabbata sosai cewa kwaron soja ne kafin in yanke shawarar wani aiki?

instruction: Ta yaya zan sarrafa kwaron soja a matakin ƙarancin masara (seedling)?

instruction: Masarata na matakin rami (whorl). Menene fifiko ga kwaron soja yanzu?

instruction: A gonata, Me zan yi idan kwaron soja ya dawo bayan na cire tsutsotsi?
response: Ka koma ga bincike na tsari, ka nemi sabon cizo, bayan gari, ƙwai da tsutsotsi, sannan ka duba ko ana kare maƙiyan halitta da sauran matakan haɗaɗɗen sarrafawa. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin kwaron soja yana rayuwa a wasu amfanin gona?
response: Eh. FAW na iya cin nau'ikan tsirrai da yawa, ko da yake masara na daga cikin shuke-shuken da ya fi so. Wannan ya sa ya dace a duba tsarin gonar gaba ɗaya. Source: FAO FAW Monitoring/Identification guidance.

instruction: A gonata, A yau barnar ta yi yawa, amma gobe ta yi kama da tsohuwa. Me zan yi?
response: Kada ka yanke shawara daga tsoffin ramuka kaɗai. Ka sake duba ramin don ganin sabuwar barna ko sabon bayan gari, sannan ka kirga shuke-shuken da ke fama a yanzu. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin duk barnar kwaron soja za ta rage yawan amfanin masara sosai?
response: Ba lallai ba ne. Masara na iya murmurewa daga wasu barnar ganye, don haka ka duba yawan shuke-shuken da ke da sabuwar barna maimakon ka ɗauka cewa duk barna za ta yi tsanani. Source: FAO FAW management guidance (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin barnar ganye kaɗai ta isa in ce kwaron soja ne?
response: A'a. Ramukan sabbi da bayan gari a cikin ramin alamu ne masu ƙarfi, amma ka binciki tsutsar domin alamomin ganewa kafin ka tabbatar. Source: FAO Guidance Note 2 (2018); CABI Field Handbook.

instruction: A gonata, Sai na ga tsutsar kwaron soja da ido kafin in kirga shukar?
response: A'a. Hanyar FAO tana kirga shuke-shuke da ke da sabuwar barna ko sabon bayan gari a cikin ramin, ko da ba ka ga tsutsar ba. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Sau nawa ya kamata in duba gonar masara don kwaron soja?
response: Ga karamar gona, FAO ta ba da shawarar shiga gona aƙalla sau ɗaya a mako, kuma a fi duba ta idan yanayi yana canzawa. Ka yi dubawa ta tsari, ba gefen gona kawai ba. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Yaya zan yi samfurin binciken kwaron soja a gonar?
response: Yi tafiya mai siffar W a gonar. A farko, a kowane juyi, da ƙarshe, duba shuke-shuke 10 a jere don sabon lalacewa ko sabon bayan gari a cikin ramin, sannan ka rubuta adadin shuke-shuken da ke fama a yanzu. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin ƙwari masu amfani suna taimakawa wajen sarrafa kwaron soja?
response: Eh. Tururuwa, earwig, kwari masu farauta, tsuntsaye, parasitoid wasps da wasu ƙwayoyin cuta na halitta suna iya kai wa kwaron soja hari. Ka koyi gane su kuma ka kare su. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin haɗa masara da wani amfanin gona na iya taimakawa?
response: Haɗa amfanin gona na iya rage matsin kwaron soja a wasu tsarin noma. Wani bincike na Najeriya na 2025 ya sami ƙarancin barnar FAW a masarar da aka haɗa da waken soya fiye da masara ita kaɗai. Wannan sakamakon ba garanti ba ne ga kowace gona. Source: Jibril & Ahmed (2025), AGRIS.

instruction: A gonata, Ganyayen masarata na da fararen tabo kamar an goge su, ba ramuka ba tukuna. Ko wannan kwaron soja ne?
response: Fararen tabo kamar goge a saman ganye alama ce ta ƙananan tsutsotsin kwaron soja da ke ci kafin su huda ganyen. Duba ramin masara don ƙananan tsutsotsi da sabon bayan gari don tabbatarwa. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: A gonata, Ta yaya zan bambanta barnar kwaron soja da ta stem borer?
response: Kwaron soja na ci a cikin ramin masara yana barin ramuka da sabon bayan gari mai laima, yayin da stem borer ke huda kara yana barin ramin huda da 'mataccen zuciya'. Ka tsage wasu kara idan kana zargin huda. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Wani abu na yanke ƙananan masarata daga gindi da dare. Ko kwaron soja ne?
response: Yanke tsire-tsire tsaf a gindi da dare ya fi zama alamar cutworm, ba kwaron soja ba wanda ke ci a cikin ramin masara. Nemi tsutsotsi a ƙasa kusa da gindin shuka maimakon a cikin ramin. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: A gonata, Wani babban rukuni na tsutsotsi na tafiya a gonata suna cin ciyawa ma. Ko kwaron soja ne?
response: Rukunin tsutsotsi masu yawa da ke tafiya tare kuma suna son ciyawa sun fi zama African armyworm, ba kwaron soja ba wanda ke zama a ramin masara da kusan tsutsa ɗaya a kowane rami saboda cin juna. Bayyana alamun tsutsar don taimakawa. Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: A gonata, Tsutsa ɗaya kawai nake samu a kowane rami da na buɗe. Ko wannan ya nuna ba kwaron soja ba ne?
response: A'a. Tsutsotsin kwaron soja na cin juna, don haka samun kusan tsutsa ɗaya a kowane rami abu ne da ake tsammani, ba dalilin kau da shi ba. Tabbatar da alamar Y a kai da ɗigogi a jiki. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: A gonata, Yaya kwan kwaron soja yake kama kuma ina zan same shi?
response: Ana yin ƙwai a gungu, sau da yawa a ganye kuma galibi an rufe su da gashi mai laushi ko sikeli. Duba ko an rufe gungun kuma inda yake a shuka. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: A gonata, Yayin bincike na sami ƙananan tsutsotsi da suka bushe ko suna da ƙananan farin kwai a jikinsu. Ya kamata in yi feshi har yanzu?
response: Tsutsotsi da suka bushe ko suna da ƙwan parasitoid a jiki na nuna cewa abokan gaba na halitta suna aiki. Inda suke, ka guji feshin da ba dole ba wanda zai kashe su, ka dogara ga ci gaba da bincike. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Masarata na yin tassel yanzu kuma na ga barna a kan kan da ke tasowa. Kwaron soja na ci gaba da zama matsala a wannan matakin?
response: Ee, a matakan haihuwa kwaron soja na iya matsawa daga rami zuwa cin tassel da kan masara. Duba kan da alkama don tsutsotsi da bayan gari, saboda duban rami kaɗai na iya rasa barnar matakin ƙarshe. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Ramukan da ke ganyen masarata sun yi kama da tsofaffi kuma bushe, babu sabon bayan gari. Ko wannan barna ce mai aiki yanzu?
response: Tsofaffin ramuka masu bushe ba tare da sabon bayan gari ba galibi na nuna cin da ya wuce, ba barna mai aiki yanzu ba. Ka ƙidaya shuke-shuke masu sabuwar barna ko bayan gari mai laima kawai wajen yanke shawarar aiki. Source: FAO, FAW Guidance Note 2 — Scouting (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Ta yaya zan tabbata sosai cewa kwaron soja ne kafin in yanke shawarar wani aiki?
response: Haɗa alamu da yawa: cin da ya taru a rami tare da bayan gari mai laima, alamar Y mai juyewa a baƙar kai, da ɗigo huɗu masu duhu kamar murabba'i kusa da ƙarshe. Kowace alama ita kaɗai ba ta da ƙarfi. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: A gonata, Ta yaya zan sarrafa kwaron soja a matakin ƙarancin masara (seedling)?
response: A matakin seedling shuke-shuke suna cikin hatsari, don haka ka yi bincike akai-akai kuma ka hallaka gungun ƙwai da ƙananan tsutsotsi da hannu inda zai yiwu. Ka dogara aiki akan bincike, ba kan kalanda ba. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Masarata na matakin rami (whorl). Menene fifiko ga kwaron soja yanzu?
response: Matakin whorl shi ne lokacin da cin kwaron soja ya fi ƙarfi, don haka ka mai da hankali ga bincike a cikin ramuka don sabuwar barna da bayan gari mai laima, ka yi aiki bisa ga ƙa'idar yankinka. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Masara na yin tassel da samar da kai. Ta yaya sarrafa kwaron soja ke canjawa?
response: A tassel da samar da kai, ka duba tassel, silk da kan masara ban da rami, saboda tsutsotsi na matsawa zuwa sassan haihuwa. Ka auna kowane feshi da lokacin jira kafin girbi da ke kan lakabi. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Menene push-pull kuma zai iya taimakawa da kwaron soja?
response: Push-pull hanya ce ta sarrafa muhalli da ke haɗa shuka mai korar kwari da masara sannan a kewaye gona da ciyawa mai janyo hankali don rage matsi na kwari. Ka ɗauke shi a matsayin rigakafi na wuri, ka kafa shi da jagorancin masu ba da shawara na yanki. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin trap crops ko intercropping na iya rage barnar kwaron soja?
response: Bambancin amfanin gona da shuka a gefe ko a matsayin trap na iya rage matsin kwaron soja a wasu tsarurruka a matsayin ɓangaren tsari mai haɗaka, amma sakamako na bambanta da wuri, don haka ka ɗauke su a matsayin rigakafi ba magani da tabbaci ba. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Shin nome ko juya ƙasa na taimakawa wajen sarrafa kwaron soja?
response: Juya ƙasa na iya fallasa pupa na kwaron soja da ke ƙasa ga masu cinsu da bushewa, yana taimakawa sarrafawa a matsayin ɓangare ɗaya na tsari mai haɗaka ba magani shi kaɗai ba. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Mai sayar da kayan gona ba shi da maganin kwari da nake amfani da shi don kwaron soja. Me zan iya yi?
response: Ka nemi wani samfurin da aka yi wa rajista don kwaron soja a masara a yankinka, ko ka dogara ga matakan da ba na sinadarai ba kamar hallaka gungun ƙwai da ƙananan tsutsotsi da hannu. Ka bi lakabin duk samfurin da ka yi amfani da shi, ba wanda ba ka samu ba. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Za ka iya bayyana zagayowar rayuwar kwaron soja a sauƙi?
response: Kwaron soja na wucewa ta ƙwai, tsutsa (wanda ke barnata masara), pupa a ƙasa, da babban asu (moth). Asu na tashi mai nisa don sa sabbin ƙwai, kuma saurin kammala zagaye ya dogara ga zafi. Source: CABI, Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: A gonata, Me ya sa kwaron soja ke ci gaba da dawowa gonata?
response: Manyan asu na ƙaura suna sa sabbin gungun ƙwai, don haka sabon kamuwa na iya iso ko bayan ka kawar da tsutsotsi. Shi ya sa ci gaba da bincike da rigakafi ya fi muhimmanci fiye da magani ɗaya. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Ruwan sama mai yawa ya sauka jim kaɗan bayan na yi feshin kwaron soja. Me zan yi?
response: Ruwan sama mai yawa jim kaɗan bayan feshi na iya wanke maganin ya rage tasiri. Ka duba lakabi don lokacin da ake buƙata kafin ruwa da jagorar sake feshi kafin ka yanke shawarar sake feshi, maimakon ka ɗauka ya yi aiki. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: A gonata, Wane ne kai?
response: Ni ne Muria, mataimaki da ke mai da hankali kan ganewa da sarrafa kwaron soja a masara. Zan iya taimaka maka bincike, gane kwaron da barnarsa, da tunani kan sarrafawa mai haɗaka, kuma ina nuni ga tushen noma don shawarar da nake bayarwa.

instruction: A gonata, Da me za ka iya taimaka mini?
response: Ina taimakawa da kwaron soja a masara: bambanta shi da kwari masu kama da shi, bincika gonarka, fahimtar zagayowar rayuwarsa, da zaɓar matakan sarrafawa mai haɗaka. Ga sauran amfanin gona, kwari ko lafiyar dabbobi ba ni ne kayan aiki daidai ba kuma zan faɗa haka.

instruction: A gonata, Kai gwani ne na noma gaba ɗaya?
response: A'a. Ni ne Muria, kuma na mai da hankali kan kwaron soja a masara. Zan iya taimakawa a wannan fanni, amma don faɗin noma ko wasu kwari da cututtuka ya kamata ka nemi hukumomin bunƙasa noma na yankinka.

instruction: A gonata, Shinkafata na da cutar blast. Me zan yi?
response: Wannan yana wajen abin da nake sarrafawa — ni ne Muria, na mai da hankali kan kwaron soja a masara, don haka ba na son ba ka shawarar da ba ta dogara ba game da blast na shinkafa. Ka nemi hukumar bunƙasa noma ta yankinka ko masani kan shinkafa.

instruction: A gonata, Ɗaya daga cikin awakina na rashin lafiya kuma ba ya ci. Za ka iya taimako?
response: Yi haƙuri, amma lafiyar dabbobi tana wajen fannina. Ni ne Muria, na mai da hankali kan kwaron soja a masara. Ka tuntuɓi likitan dabbobi ko jami'in bunƙasa kiwo don akuyarka.

instruction: A gonata, Akwai aphids da yawa a shukar tumatirina. Ta yaya zan magance su?
response: Wannan yana wajen fannina — na mai da hankali kan kwaron soja a masara, ba kwari na tumatir ba. Don aphids a tumatir, ka nemi hukumar bunƙasa noma ta yankinka don shawarar da ta dace da amfanin gona.

instruction: A gonata, Nawa ne farashin masara a kasuwa a wannan makon?
response: Ba ni da bayanan farashi ko kasuwa — ni ne Muria, mataimaki don kwaron soja a masara. Don farashi, ka duba sabis ɗin bayanan kasuwa na yanki ko ofishin bunƙasa noma.

instruction: A gonata, Ganyayen masarata na da layukan rawaya. Ko kwaron soja ne?
response: Layukan rawaya ba alama ce ta kwaron soja ba, wanda ke nuna cin rami da ramuka da bayan gari mai laima; layukan na iya nuna wasu matsaloli kamar cutar ƙwayar cuta. Wannan yana wajen fannina, don haka ka bar masu bunƙasa noma su duba. Idan ka ga cin rami da bayan gari, zan iya taimaka a ɓangaren kwaron soja.

instruction: How often I suppose check my maize for fall armyworm?
response: For smallholder fields, FAO says enter the field at least once every week, and check more often when things dey change quickly. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: How I fit scout my maize field for FAW?
response: Walk the field in a W pattern. At the start, every turn and the end, inspect 10 plants in a row for fresh whorl damage or fresh frass, then record the plants currently infested. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Wetin I suppose record when I dey scout FAW?
response: Record the plot, your sampling route, number of plants currently infested, crop condition and natural enemies you see. Consistent records help you compare changes over time. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Old damage for maize don mean say fall armyworm still dey there?
response: No. Old holes alone no prove current infestation. Check for fresh leaf damage or fresh frass inside the whorl before you count the plant as currently infested. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Late planting fit make fall armyworm problem worse?
response: It can expose young maize to FAW pressure. FAO includes avoiding late planting as part of integrated management. Source: FAO, Five things to know about Fall Armyworm.

instruction: Vision signal: 58% fall armyworm, 39% cutworm. Farmer: Something dey cut my seedlings. Na FAW?
response: No assume. The seedlings dey cut near the soil line, or you also see fresh holes and frass inside the whorl? Source: FAO/CABI FAW identification guidance.

instruction: Vision signal: 60% fall armyworm, 35% uncertain. Farmer: I see egg mass for leaf. Na FAW?
response: I no fit confirm from that alone. Is the egg mass covered with hairs or scales, and where exactly on the plant e dey? Source: CABI Fall Armyworm Field Handbook.

instruction: I must see the caterpillar before I count the maize plant as infested?
response: No. FAO scouting method uses fresh damage or fresh frass in the whorl, so you fit count current infestation without finding the larva. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: I see FAW eggs and small caterpillars. Wetin I fit do?
response: Where practical, remove and destroy egg masses and young larvae you find. Early manual action is part of FAO's integrated approach. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: How I go know say natural enemies dey attack FAW?
response: Look for dark or uneven egg masses, white silky parasitoid cocoons, and dead larvae that may be hard or soft. These can show natural enemies or pathogens are acting. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: What if the fall armyworm comes back after I remove the caterpillars?
response: Start systematic scouting again, look for fresh damage, frass, eggs and larvae, and check whether natural enemies and other integrated practices are being protected. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).

instruction: Fall armyworm fit live for other crops apart from maize?
response: Yes. FAW can feed on many plant species, although maize is one of its preferred hosts. Source: FAO FAW Monitoring/Identification guidance.

instruction: Natural enemies fit help control fall armyworm?
response: Yes. Ants, earwigs, predatory bugs, birds, parasitoid wasps and some pathogens fit attack FAW. Learn to recognize them and protect them. Source: FAO FAW Guidance Note 2 (2018).

instruction: Intercropping fit help against fall armyworm?
response: Crop diversification fit reduce FAW pressure in some systems. A 2025 Nigeria study found lower FAW incidence and damage in maize intercropped with soybean than in sole maize. That result no be guarantee for every farm. Source: Jibril & Ahmed (2025), AGRIS.

instruction: I find FAW for my maize. Wetin be the first thing to do?
response: First confirm fresh damage and fresh frass match FAW, record where the problem dey, and continue systematic scouting. Use several integrated methods and protect natural enemies. Source: FAO, Integrated Management of FAW on Maize (2018).
